# Requirements Quality Checklist: Unambiguous skill names and a standards-conforming front page

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements in `spec.md` are complete, clear, mutually consistent, and testable, before planning turns them into work. Every item asks about what the spec **says**, never about whether the implementation works.
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the set of things a rename must move — the name a user types, the name a skill declares, the name one skill dispatches, the location a skill reads a helper from, and prose mentions — enumerated in the requirements rather than left to the reader to infer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what the front page must contain, as distinct from the order it must present it in? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-011, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Is there a requirement covering the front-page content that already exists and must survive the rewrite, not only the content being added? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements stated for the licence document itself — that it exists, and that it agrees with the manifest — rather than only for the sentence that points at it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec state what must be true of the published record's citations, including the enforced-versus-conventional distinction, in checkable terms? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the boundaries stated as requirements the implementation can violate, rather than only as a prose list of non-goals? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §FR-015, §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK007 Is there a requirement fixing how many skills the plugin ships after the change, so that an accidental sixth or a leftover fifth is detectable? [Completeness, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec say anything about who or what is expected to detect a partial rename, or is detection left entirely to the reader? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "the plugin's live content" defined precisely enough that a reviewer can say, of any given file, whether FR-006 applies to it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "presented as current" distinguishable from a historical mention of an old name, given that FR-006 forbids one and FR-017 preserves the other? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "the name of the container it ships in" specific enough to be checked without knowing the implementation's file layout? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "the bookkeeping files the pipeline skill writes during a run" enumerable from the spec alone, or must a reader open the skill to know which files FR-014 protects? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "without depending on the plugin's namespace to disambiguate it" stated as a property a reviewer can evaluate, rather than as a rationale? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Does FR-015's phrase "except for the names themselves and the references to them" draw a line a reviewer could apply to a borderline edit, such as a sentence rewritten because the new name changed its length? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "an authoritative source" defined or exemplified, so that FR-018 cannot be satisfied by citing an arbitrary third-party page? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the order FR-009 mandates stated as a strict sequence, or could an implementation satisfy it with the five topics present but interleaved? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK017 Do FR-006 (no old name presented as current anywhere in live content) and FR-017 (the two superseded records keep their old names) agree on whether those records are live content? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK018 Do FR-014 (bookkeeping filenames unchanged) and FR-006 (every reference renamed) agree on the status of a filename that contains an old skill name as a substring? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK019 Are FR-003 (new names must not collide with the personal skills) and the Assumptions entry stating those personal copies may remain installed consistent about whether removal is a precondition? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Do FR-004 (exactly one skill reachable only by name) and FR-015 (no behavioural change) agree that FR-004 restates an existing property rather than introducing one? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK021 Do FR-016 (no stub under an old name) and FR-001 (all five addressable under new names) together fix the shipped skill count without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-016, §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the same term used throughout for the thing being renamed — is the spec consistent between "skill", "distributed skill" and "plugin skill"? [Consistency, Terminology]
- [ ] CHK023 Do the five new names appear identically everywhere they occur in the spec, with no variant spelling between the user stories, the requirements and the success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §User Story 1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 Can each success criterion be evaluated without reading the implementation diff? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 through §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the counting criteria unambiguous about what is being counted — is SC-002's "zero references that resolve to a name that no longer exists" countable by a reviewer who has not been told where references live? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK026 Is SC-003 distinguishable in practice from SC-002, or do they restate one condition twice? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK027 Does SC-006 state who the reader is and what counts as success, given that "can install using only the front page" depends on the reader's prior knowledge? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK028 Is SC-008's "existing aggregate quality check" identified precisely enough to be run, without naming an implementation? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK029 Does every functional requirement have at least one success criterion or acceptance scenario that would fail if the requirement were violated? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements, §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK030 Are the acceptance scenarios in each user story written so that the Given state is reachable and the Then outcome is observable? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 1 through §User Story 5]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements present for the primary flow — a user invoking each renamed skill directly? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements present for the alternate flow — one skill reaching another, rather than a user reaching a skill? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements present for the exception flow — a reference that fails to resolve after the change? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements present for the documentation-reader flow, independently of any skill being invoked? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK035 Are recovery or rollback requirements stated for a rename that is found to be partial after it ships, or is that intentionally out of scope? [Gap, Recovery Flow]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the flow of a reader arriving at a superseded record covered by a requirement, and not only by a user story? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, §User Story 5]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK037 Is the behaviour on invoking an old name specified for both the machine that still has the personal copy and the machine that does not? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the case of a user who has independently created a personal skill under one of the _new_ names addressed, and is the spec's position on it stated as a scope boundary rather than left open? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the partial-rename state characterised as a failure state in the requirements, rather than only discussed in the edge-case narrative? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the in-flight-run case — a pipeline run holding bookkeeping written before the change — resolved by a requirement rather than by an assumption? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK041 Are boundary conditions stated for the shared helper: what must be true if zero copies, or more than one, are found? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §SC-005]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK042 Are requirements stated for the quality bar the change must clear, and is that bar identified without naming a tool? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK043 Are there requirements about the discoverability of the new names for an existing user — or is the front page the only stated channel, and is that stated deliberately? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK044 Does the spec state any requirement about the change being reviewable — for example that the diff to the superseded records is minimal — in checkable terms? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK045 Are accessibility, localisation or presentation requirements for the front page either specified or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK046 Is the assumption that the plugin's namespace continues to work stated, and is the feature's behaviour defined if it does not? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK047 Is the assumption that the current skill content is authoritative — with no upstream reconciled — recorded where a reader of the requirements will see it? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK048 Is the dependency on the licence already declared by the manifest stated as a dependency, so that FR-012 is not read as choosing a licence? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK049 Is the assumption that existing quality checks pass unmodified stated, and is it clear that relaxing one is not an acceptable route to SC-008? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK050 Are the two superseded records identified specifically enough that a reviewer can tell whether FR-017 has been applied to the right files? [Traceability, Spec §FR-017]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK051 Does any requirement depend on a term that the spec uses but never defines? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK052 Is there any requirement that could be satisfied in a way that violates a stated non-goal? [Conflict, Spec §FR-014 through §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK053 Is a requirement-and-criterion identifier scheme established and used consistently, so every item above can point at something stable? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK017, CHK018 and CHK026 are the three items most likely to surface a real defect: the first two probe boundaries where two requirements could both be read as governing the same file, and the third asks whether two success criteria are one criterion written twice
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
